candidate.claim: listitem mutates the input token in place (prepends checkbox to text and unshifts a new token), so rendering the same tokens a second time prepends/unshifts the checkbox again and double-counts it.
candidate.title: Renderer.listitem mutates tokens causing duplicate checkbox on re-render

verifier.reason: Renderer.ts:80-92 mutates the loose task item in place by prepending the checkbox to paragraph/text token text and by unshifting a new checkbox text token in the else branch, with no guard, clearing of item.task, or already-present check, so calling listitem again on the same tokens at Renderer.ts:75-99 reapplies the checkbox.
